tasks.title: [M7] Offline custom actions and explicit runtime-support reporting
tasks.description:
**Project:** RO Sprite Forge (oq6fp33cmdnwl5h0v48zcr3u)
**Milestone:** M7
**Stable plan reference:** RSF-v1.1/M7-04
**Implementation status:** Implemented; independent QA_PASS. Accepted transition is recorded by the live Kaneo column. Live Kaneo column is authoritative.
**Responsible implementer:** Codex `aM3as9DCoQ7pMoO3V9XsDbL3q2j9pWjn`; independent configured reviewer is separate.
**Source reference:** docs/architecture/RO_SPRITE_FORGE_COMPREHENSIVE_IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN_v1.1.md §§3.1–3.2, 4.7, 6/M7, 10.2
**Planning source SHA-256:** 5edfbebcdb47620c59a915e8874094f35092125dd0444b79468aa55a191a361e

## Problem and expected outcome

**Objective:** Allow declared actions without pretending the runtime can select them.

**Scope:** Custom Guard/Dodge IDs, finite target topology, format-permitted compile and compatibility diagnostics.

## Acceptance criteria

- [x] Declare new Guard/Dodge offline actions with frame/view/layer topology and stable IDs without changing original inventories.
- [x] Compile where the format permits using existing approval/export policies, while reporting runtime UNSUPPORTED until a separately verified mapping exists.
- [x] Any native-support claim requires pinned requested/resolved exact action/view/slot evidence; fallback remains diagnostic.
- [x] Custom action support never authorizes Korangar/rAthena source changes or infers gameplay behavior.

## Verification

Synthetic declaration/compile/oracle and unsupported/fallback status checks; actual native proof required only if runtime support is claimed.

Record actual commands, environment/tool versions, exit statuses, artifact hashes and NOT_RUN blockers at handoff. No tests, approvals or native runs are claimed by this planning record.

## Non-goals and dependencies

**Dependencies:** RSF-32 (M7-01; task ID wbh6jvha6imo9jeub9zmhovj); RSF-25 (M5-03; task ID udjjt7jp22k3owbo05s8mnf8)

**Non-goals / gate qualifications:** Only the stated deliverable; no adjacent milestone implementation or automatic artistic/native acceptance.

Original Ragnarok artwork/GRFs and private fixtures stay outside public Git/deliverables. Use synthetic redistributable fixtures for public verification. Private fixture/tool availability must be checked during execution, never assumed.

## Implementation evidence (add at QA handoff)

- Code: optional target offline-action contract; action-local topology/review identity; existing compositor/timeline preview; diagnostic existing-slot binding; compatible registry extension. Exact paths/baseline hashes and bounded diff: docs/verification/rsf-35/implementation-paths.json and implementation.diff.
- Self-checks exit 0: focused18, public636, private52run/51PASS/1legacy skip, Rust11, schema13, installed distribution636run/624PASS/12optional skips (4jsonschema,8Rust executable). Repeat Guard/Dodge ACT/SPR/build-manifest bytes identical. Logs and synthetic hashes: docs/verification/rsf-35/. Python3.14.4 tested;3.12/3.13 unavailable. No browser/client change, browser/native GPU NOT_RUN.
- Runtime Guard/Dodge/Wave UNSUPPORTED/native UNVERIFIED; diagnostic storage slot8 never runtime mapping. Production rejected; existing mappings/resources preserved. Final live RSF-32/33/34/35 read-back: all Accepted, all four criteria checked each. M7 FULLY_ACCEPTED within plan scope; new custom action runtime UNSUPPORTED/native UNVERIFIED.

## Independent QA result (reviewer reports, coordinator syncs)

**QA_PASS** — configured independent forge_qa_reviewer `/root/rsf35_qa`. Independently executed focused18, public636, private52run/51PASS/1legacy skip, Rust11, schema13, distribution636run/624PASS/12optional skips, two reproductions and a fresh binary/pixel/production-rejection probe. For each Guard/Dodge:49 occurrences compared,exactly1target changed,48unaffected;direct Rust AGREEMENT0mismatches. All15repeatartifacts byte-identical across paths/hashseed97. All12implementationhashes and137unchangedbaselinefiles verified. No product findings/corrections needed. No reviewer source edits/tracker writes/ownership changes/artistic approval. Full report:docs/verification/rsf-35/QA_REPORT.md; original logs/probe:independent-qa/. Runtime UNSUPPORTED/native UNVERIFIED for new actions; existing bounded M5 evidence remains separate.

## Final implementation and M7 record

Implementation manifest: docs/verification/rsf-35/implementation-manifest.json SHA-256 fe42fff9ea138e40849eaaff36baa6ec9d1505eed0ef5ea6cf77dc05756403c2.
